name: AccountUserProfile
title: Blocks/Account/AccountUserProfile
summary: One page for an Azion user's profile and personal settings, a page body for ConsoleLayout's default slot. A compact header (a 48 px `Avatar`, the name, a role `Tag`, handle, location and join year, a `CopyButton` for the profile link and an Edit profile `Button`) sits over `PageTabs`: Overview, Profile and bio, Security and access, Notifications and Preferences. Overview shows five `StatTile`s in a `StatTileGroup` for the selected year, a `Card` with a `ContributionGraph` (category and cell-shape `ToggleGroup`s, a year rail of `Button`s that switches year over year, a day click that filters the history) and a `Card` with a month-grouped `Timeline` of contributions, or an `EmptyState`. The settings tabs are `SettingsGroup`s over flush `Card`s of `SettingsRow`s: profile fields, `PhoneInput`, `LanguageSelect` and visibility `Switch`es; `PasswordInput` with `PasswordRequirements`, multi-factor and personal tokens, locked with an info `Alert` and a warning `Tag` when the organization's SSO and SCIM provider manages them; three scheduled digests and real-time alerts as `Select`s; `ThemeSwitcher` and a Keyboard shortcuts `Switch`. A `SaveBar` appears with unsaved changes (Discard, Save changes with its Command S hint unless shortcuts are off). Loading draws `Skeleton`s; a load failure is a danger `Alert` with Retry.
